title: Aston Villa’s Emi Martinez, Jadon Sancho return to training before Europa League quarter-final
content:
Emiliano Martinez and Jadon Sancho trained on Wednesday ahead of Aston Villa’s Europa League quarter-final second leg against Bologna.

Martinez, 33, missed Villa’s 1-1 draw away to Nottingham Forest on Sunday after complaining of a calf issue in the warm-up. It was the third time this season that the Argentina international had pulled out of a game while warming up.

Martinez, despite managing a calf issue for a lot of the campaign, trained with the squad on Wednesday morning.

“Martinez is training with us. Normally he will be available tomorrow and tomorrow we will decide,” Unai Emery said of the goalkeeper in his pre-match press conference on Wednesday.

Jadon Sancho has also returned after suffering a shoulder issue over the international break. The winger has made 31 appearances in all competitions this season but only 17 of those have been starts.

“He’s (Sancho) coming back and of course he’s a fantastic player,” Emery continued. “He needs to be consistent and I think he is being demanding. He adapted in our structure, getting better. It’s a pity he was injured as he finished before the international break fantastic.”

Tyrone Mings, who missed the trip to Forest with a minor heel issue, was also back, with only Ross Barkley and Alysson also training but cannot feature against Bologna due to not being registered in Villa’s Europa League squad.

Villa are leading Bologna 3-1 on aggregate after goals from Ezri Konsa and two from Ollie Watkins in the first leg last Thursday. Should they progress into the final four of the Europa League, Emery’s side will either face Forest or Porto.
